preconditions.description: The number of cities being attacked must be between 1 and the total number of cities, inclusive.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: All city numbers in the roads must be within the valid range of city indices.

preconditions.expression: len(attacked_cities) == m and all(1 <= city <= n for city in attacked_cities)
preconditions.description: The number of attacked cities must match m, and all city numbers must be valid.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the city number where Super M should teleport.
The output must end with the minimum time needed to scare all humans in the attacked cities.

postconditions.expression: optimal_city == min(city for city in range(1, n + 1) if min_time == calculate_time(city))
postconditions.description: The chosen city must be the one with the lowest number among those that achieve the minimum time.
